ordinary_goal: Which catalogued capabilities suit these research questions?
rule: For each positive query issue one ordinary native gx_query_catalog textual request with no forced inputs, named outputs, provider, category or activation. Inspect the first five entries actually returned, including reference cards. Score once if at least one named acceptable reference is installed and selectable or already active in this ordinary Goal. Look up technical readiness on detail cards separately; this is retrieval and no execution claim. Score both languages separately with their raw denominators. Record all raw top-five references/statuses, reference-only hits, empty pages and paired success. Historical target is expected as reference_only, never executable. A true absent method needs an empty result, not simply absence of the named target.
